delivery.outcome: A reusable POA v1 standard with closed authoring, binding, observation, planning, execution, event and receipt contracts plus deterministic conformance
nonGoals: Do not implement a runtime or generic remote executor
Do not grant authority to an LLM, DSL document, URI resolver or transport
Do not carry credentials, shell commands or arbitrary transport configuration
Do not push implementation directly to main, merge, tag or publish a release

architecture.decision: Keep typed process definition, request, plan and receipt data separate from external policy, grant, execution and verification authorities.
dataChanges: Introduce the experimental wellmanifest.poa/v1 document family
Represent simultaneous effects as a bounded set rather than one lossy class
Bind canonical plan and receipt hashes to RFC 8785 plus SHA-256
architecture.rollback: Remove the five ticket-owned standard files while preserving the governed baseline and ticket evidence.
